record.original_question: Does there exist a Cohen-Macaulay CW complex Gamma such that, for every choice of linear system of parameters Theta, the Artinian reduction S/(I_{sd(Gamma)} + (Theta)) of the Stanley-Reisner ring of the barycentric subdivision sd(Gamma) fails the weak Lefschetz property?

evidence.quote: Question 4.5. Is there a Cohen–Macaulay CW complex Γ such that S/(Isd(Γ) + (Θ)) does not have the weak Lefschetz property for any linear system of parameters Θ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Gamma$ be a regular CW complex with vertex set $V$, and let $\mathrm{sd}(\Gamma)$ denote its (order-complex) barycentric subdivision: the abstract simplicial complex whose vertices are the (nonempty) cells of $\Gamma$ and whose faces are the chains of cells ordered by inclusion. Let $\Bbbk$ be an infinite field, write $S = \Bbbk[x_F : F \text{ a cell of } \Gamma]$, and let $I_{\mathrm{sd}(\Gamma)} \subset S$ be the Stanley–Reisner ideal of $\mathrm{sd}(\Gamma)$, generated by the squarefree monomials $x_{F_1}\cdots x_{F_k}$ corresponding to non-chains in the face poset of $\Gamma$. Assume $\Gamma$ is Cohen–Macaulay over $\Bbbk$ (equivalently, $S/I_{\mathrm{sd}(\Gamma)}$ is a Cohen–Macaulay ring of Krull dimension $d = \dim\Gamma + 1$). A linear system of parameters (l.s.o.p.) for $S/I_{\mathrm{sd}(\Gamma)}$ is a sequence $\Theta = (\theta_1,\dots,\theta_d)$ of linear forms in $S$ whose images form a homogeneous system of parameters in $S/I_{\mathrm{sd}(\Gamma)}$; the corresponding Artinian reduction is $A(\Gamma,\Theta) := S/(I_{\mathrm{sd}(\Gamma)} + (\Theta))$. The Artinian graded $\Bbbk$-algebra $A(\Gamma,\Theta)$ has the weak Lefschetz property (WLP) if there exists a linear form $\ell \in A(\Gamma,\Theta)_1$ such that for every $i$, the multiplication map $\cdot \ell : A(\Gamma,\Theta)_i \to A(\Gamma,\Theta)_{i+1}$ has full rank.

Question: Does there exist a Cohen–Macaulay regular CW complex $\Gamma$ such that, for every choice of linear system of parameters $\Theta$, the Artinian reduction $A(\Gamma,\Theta) = S/(I_{\mathrm{sd}(\Gamma)} + (\Theta))$ fails to satisfy the weak Lefschetz property?
artifact.status_search_result: The literature establishes positive WLP results in special cases (e.g., barycentric subdivisions of shellable complexes have an "almost strong Lefschetz" property; odd-dimensional Cohen–Macaulay cases are known to satisfy WLP), and the question of whether some Cohen–Macaulay CW complex has barycentric subdivision failing WLP for every l.s.o.p. does not appear to have been resolved in published follow-up work. No paper located explicitly settles the question.

status_evidence.title: The Lefschetz property for barycentric subdivisions of shellable complexes
status_evidence.snippet: An 'almost strong Lefschetz' property holds for barycentric subdivisions of shellable complexes; h-vector is unimodal.
status_evidence.claim: Positive Lefschetz-type results known for shellable cases, but the general Cohen–Macaulay CW question remains.

status_evidence.title: Weak Lefschetz Property and Stellar Subdivisions of Gorenstein Complexes
status_evidence.snippet: Studies WLP behavior under subdivisions of Gorenstein complexes.
status_evidence.claim: Related results on WLP under subdivisions, no resolution of the general CM CW question.
